column1: # How the GAME turns an Active minimap icon into its Inactive one, sampled from its own art.
# Cut from assets/icons.png by the pairs assets/icon-names.tsv names: every cell called
# <X>Active beside the cell called <X>Inactive, solid pixels only (alpha > 200), twelve
# pixels spread across each icon. Only the pairs the game greyed by a plain rule are here
# - mean error under 2.5 of 255 against grey = mean(r,g,b) * k - because the rest were
# repainted by hand and say nothing about a rule. Over ALL 163 pairs in the sheet the
# form still holds: the Inactive art is fully desaturated (mean residual saturation 0.19
# of 255) and keeps its alpha (141 of 163 unchanged); only the factor is inconsistent.
# k spans 0.59 to 0.99 here, median 0.792; over the 27 BOSS pairs it is
# 0.47 to 1.14 with median 0.776, which is where PictureGrey.Measured comes from - and why
# the pane carries a slider rather than one number.
